title: Syrian-Style Kebabs
description: A flavorful and vegetarian twist on traditional kebabs, made with tender portobello mushrooms and a blend of Middle Eastern spices.

ingredients.name: Gently spiced
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use a vegetarian-friendly spice blend

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp garlic (minced), 1 tsp smoked paprika, and 1 tsp salt.
Add the portobello mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated mushrooms onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender and lightly charred.
Meanwhile, toast the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for 5 minutes.
Serve the kebabs in the toasted pita bread with tzatziki sauce and garnished with chopped parsley.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
